question: Which of the following methods is commonly used to prevent rancidity in packaged food items?

options.text: Flushing with nitrogen gas before sealing

solution:
The correct answer is __**Flushing with nitrogen gas before sealing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Flushing with nitrogen gas before sealing** is a widely used method to prevent rancidity in packaged food items. Nitrogen replaces oxygen inside the packaging, which helps in slowing down the oxidation of fats and oils, a primary cause of rancidity.
 
• **Oxidation** occurs when oxygen reacts with fats and oils in food, leading to unpleasant odors and flavors. By removing oxygen, nitrogen ensures longer shelf life and maintains food quality.
